title: clytostomanthus decorus
intro:
Clytostomanthus decorus, commonly known as the decorative beautyberry, is a flowering shrub native to tropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of this plant include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Clytostomanthus decorus include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.

Note: Clytostomanthus decorus is a plant species in the family Combretaceae.
